title: Your apps wind you up. DeRot brings you back down.

copy.instagram_caption:
Your apps wind you up. DeRot brings you back down.

Here's the idea. You pick the apps that tend to leave you wired. Mid-scroll, DeRot pauses the feed and walks you through about a minute of slow, easy breathing. Then you go back, or you don't. Either way, you're calmer.

No account. No guilt charts. You're never locked out of anything.

Coming soon to iPhone. Join the launch list: link in bio.
